hypothesis: Using candidate only for SELL/risk-reducing execution while retaining baseline BUY/other policy will improve drawdown without reducing useful trading.
expected: SELL completion and inventory reduction improve while round trips, quote uptime, PnL and fill activity remain non-inferior to baseline.
rootCause: The SELL-only target activated a full-inventory risk-reducing IOC. Once inventory reached zero, the baseline BUY side had no executable inventory-replenishment opportunity under the existing gates in this window. The resulting lower drawdown was obtained by liquidation and loss of round trips, not by a stable two-sided policy.
competingExplanations: The explicit queueMultiplier=0 replay assumption may overstate maker fills and does not model L2 queue priority.
The calibration sample is insufficient and asymmetric (5 BUY / 13 SELL versus 21 per side required).
Real exchange latency, partial fills, callback ordering and stale-BBO replan parity are not established.
missedGates: No fill-collapse / no near-zero-trading promotion gate
prevention: Keep candidate/hybrid research-only and keep all hard risk gates unchanged.
Reject a result when lower drawdown coincides with zero BUY, zero round trips, or materially lower fill activity.
Require multiple non-overlapping windows, non-zero calibrated queue model, partial-fill/latency simulation and private-fill calibration before promotion.
Retain the sell-only fallback counter and fast-target SELL source in replay artifacts.

applicability.regime: short replay window; exact market regime not generalized
